activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the history of sports and its importance
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of the history and development of sports in Tanzania
activities.learning_activity: Explain the historical development of sports in Tanzania from international and national perspectives (development, spread and impacts)
suggested_methods: Group discussion: Guide students in manageable groups to discuss the historical development of sports in Tanzania from international perspective
Group Discussion: Organise students in manageable groups to discuss the historical development of sports in Tanzania from national perspective
Plenary discussion: Lead plenary discussion to summarise ideals generated from the group discussions
activities.assessment_criteria: The historical development of sports in Tanzania from international and national are well explained
suggested_resources: sport sessions in television and radio

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of the relationship between human physiology and performance in sports
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate a basic understanding of the structure and functions of the human body systems
activities.learning_activity: Describe the structure and functions of human body systems that relate to physical exercises and sports (musculoskeletal, cardiovascular, respiratory, nervous, endocrine and digestive systems)
suggested_methods: Group discussion: Task students in manageable groups to analyse the structure and functions of human body systems that relate to physical exercise and sports
activities.assessment_criteria: The structures and functions of human body systems related to physical exercises and sports are well described

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of the relationship between human physiology and performance in sports
activities.specific_competence: 2.2 Demonstrate a basic understanding of the role of human body systems and movements in sports
activities.learning_activity: Apply the knowledge of various body systems (musculoskeletal, cardiovascular, respiratory, nervous, endocrine and digestive systems) to enhance performance in physical exercises and selected sports: Athletics (running, throwing and jumping), swimming, football, netball, basketball, table tennis, tennis volleyball and handball
suggested_methods: Demonstration and practice: Perform an instructional activity as students observe
Guide students to practice what they have learnt from demonstration in relation to body systems
activities.assessment_criteria: Knowledge of skeletal, muscular, circulatory, respiratory, nervous, digestive and endocrine systems are well applied in physical exercises and selected sports

activities.learning_activity: (a) Describe principles of training in sports (specificity, overload, progression, variety, recovery, individuality and consistency)
suggested_methods: Jigsaw: Task students through jigsaw, to explore specific principles of training in sports and exercises
activities.assessment_criteria: Principles of training in sports and exercises are well described

activities.learning_activity: (b) Apply principles of training in selected sports: Athletics (running, throwing and jumping), swimming, football and netball
suggested_methods: Demonstration: Perform various activities that apply principles of training in selected sports
Guide students to practice various skills by observing principles of training in selected sports
activities.assessment_criteria: Principles of training in selected sports: Athletics (running, throwing and jumping), swimming, football and netball are well applied

activities.specific_competence: 3.2 Develop advanced skills in selected sports
activities.learning_activity: (a) Perform advanced tactics and drills in selected sports (principles, systems and styles of play)
suggested_methods: Guided practice: Organize students in manageable groups and guide them to perform advanced tactics and drills in selected sports
activities.assessment_criteria: Advanced tactics and drills in selected sports are well performed

activities.specific_competence: 3.2 Develop advanced skills in selected sports
activities.learning_activity: (b) Play by observing rules and regulations governing selected sports: Athletics (running, throwing and jumping), swimming, football and netball
suggested_methods: Guided practice: Guide students to form teams and play by observing rules and regulations governing selected sports
Peer teaching: Lead students to give feedback to each other on how rules and regulations are observed when practicing
activities.assessment_criteria: Rules and regulations are well observed in playing selected sports: Athletics (running, throwing and jumping), swimming, football and netball

activities.main_competence: 4.0 Demonstrate mastery of the basic principles of sports management and administration
activities.specific_competence: 4.1 Demonstrate an understanding of basic principles of leadership, administration and management in sports
activities.learning_activity: (a) Describe the principles of sports management, leadership and administration (theories, skills and functions)
suggested_methods: Group discussion: Lead students to discuss principles of sport management, leadership and administration
activities.assessment_criteria: The principles of sport management, leadership and administration are well described

activities.main_competence: 4.0 Demonstrate mastery of the basic principles of sports management and administration
activities.specific_competence: 4.1 Demonstrate an understanding of basic principles of leadership, administration and management in sports
activities.learning_activity: (b) Describe the leadership, administrative and managerial structures of sport organisations
suggested_methods: Role play/ simulation: Assign students to perform simulation game on administrative and managerial positions of sport organizations
Lead students to discuss lessons learnt from simulation and relate with leadership, administrative and managerial structures of sport organizations
activities.assessment_criteria: The leadership, administrative and managerial structures of sport organizations are well described

activities.specific_competence: 5.1 Design and conduct a project in sports
activities.learning_activity: Design and execute a project in sports
suggested_methods: Project: Task students in pairs to conduct a project in sports
activities.assessment_criteria: The project in sports is well designed and executed
suggested_resources: sports sessions in television and radio
